departureImport.warning: A relative departure report is not an exact departure date. Events with identical age text are preserved separately; repeated names do not establish identity across all records. Join and departure messages are not forcibly paired.
departureImport.note: Restored literal | within the username Axxoy | The Last Samurai; separator is part of the name.

removalImport.source: SMMO guild removal notification batch supplied 2026-10-29
